name: Barkhesh
description: Barkhesh was a planet located in the Barkhesh system of the Seitia sector within the Outer Rim Territories and Western Reaches. It was located in grid square K-19 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Barkhesh was the homeworld of the human Antidar Williams, a Galactic Republic Judicial who perished in the Naboo system in 32 BBY.
